title: anthemis pseudoabrotanifolia
intro: Anthemis pseudoabrotanifolia, commonly known as a type of chamomile, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis pseudoabrotanifolia are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm inflammatory responses, and provide relief from insomnia and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
